official_measurement_examples: HELAA identifies potential future land supply
assessment considers suitability availability and achievability
HELAA does not itself allocate land
HELAA does not itself grant planning permission
constraints must be recorded rather than silently removed
development potential is an evidence estimate not permissioned yield
local HELAA map update date must be retained separately from site status
HELAA inclusion does not establish ownership or final development yield
core_rules: development potential is not final yield
constraint mitigation is not assumed complete
five-year supply use is distinct from allocation
brownfield-register use is distinct from HELAA status
local methodology can differ but must be identified
map geometry is not cadastral ownership geometry
no parcel HELAA clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
source_verification_note: Official MHCLG/GOV.UK and current English local-authority HELAA/SHLAA sources checked 2026-07-26. July/June 2026 local updates and evidence-versus-allocation distinction retained; no parcel promotion.
